title: interactiveRows without checkbox makes rows look clickable but do nothing
description: The row's cursor/hover affordance is gated on `interactiveRows` alone (line 74: `className={interactiveRows ? "cursor-pointer hover-bg" : undefined}`), but the actual click handler is gated on `interactiveRows && checkbox` (line 76: `onClick={interactiveRows && checkbox ? () => checkbox.onToggle(col.name) : undefined}`). When a caller passes `interactiveRows` without a `checkbox` (which the public prop types permit — both are independent optional props), every row renders with a pointer cursor and hover highlight yet clicking does nothing. The affordance and the behaviour disagree. The two conditions should share the same gate (e.g. derive `const rowInteractive = interactiveRows && !!checkbox` and use it for both the className and onClick), or the cursor/hover styling should also require `checkbox`.
evidence: Line 74 keys pointer+hover on `interactiveRows`; line 76 keys onClick on `interactiveRows && checkbox`. With `interactiveRows` true and `checkbox` undefined => `cursor-pointer hover-bg` applied but `onClick` is undefined => dead affordance.
